title: Game entity hierarchy
goal: Model game entities, dependent components, and rendering capability.

rubric.must: Player and NonPlayerCharacter generalize to Entity, and Boss generalizes to NonPlayerCharacter.
Filled composition diamonds connect Player to HealthComponent and InventoryComponent.
Player realizes Renderable with a dashed hollow-triangle arrow and Renderer depends on Renderable.
InventoryComponent aggregates Item with a hollow diamond and 0..* multiplicity.
Entity visibly shows protected # position and Player shows public + operations.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the umlclass exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly represents the requested hierarchy, component compositions, rendering relationships, item aggregation, and visibility markers. Connections are traceable and labels are readable, with no material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: Player and NonPlayerCharacter connect to Entity with hollow-triangle generalization arrows; Boss connects to NonPlayerCharacter the same way.
Filled diamonds at Player connect to HealthComponent and InventoryComponent.
Player realizes Renderable with a dashed hollow-triangle arrow. Renderer has a dashed dependency arrow to Renderable labeled “draws.”
InventoryComponent connects to Item with a hollow aggregation diamond, and the Item end is labeled 0..*.
Entity shows protected # position; Player shows public + score and + move().
